chore(derived_code_mappings): Stop reporting some errors (#44741)

One of the errors we raise to the top task in order to prevent further processing. The other error is harmless and can continue execution.

This will remove some of the errors that are being grouped under .

You can [see all mixed errors](https://sentry.sentry.io/discover/results/?field=issue&field=title&field=count%28%29&name=ApiError%3A+%7B%22message%22%3A%22Repository+access+blocked%22%2C%22block%22%3A%7B%22reason%22%3A%22dmca%22%2C%22created_at%22%3A%222015-10-02T22%3A05%3A18...&project=1&query=issue%3ASENTRY-YRS&sort=-title&statsPeriod=90d&yAxis=count%28%29) if you group them in Discover.

chore(derived_code_mappings): Stop reporting some errors (#44741)

One of the errors we raise to the top task in order to prevent further processing. The other error is harmless and can continue execution.

This will remove some of the errors that are being grouped under .

You can [see all mixed errors](https://sentry.sentry.io/discover/results/?field=issue&field=title&field=count%28%29&name=ApiError%3A+%7B%22message%22%3A%22Repository+access+blocked%22%2C%22block%22%3A%7B%22reason%22%3A%22dmca%22%2C%22created_at%22%3A%222015-10-02T22%3A05%3A18...&project=1&query=issue%3ASENTRY-YRS&sort=-title&statsPeriod=90d&yAxis=count%28%29) if you group them in Discover.
